libs.note: BH-9779. The plan gate reads the plan's `## Verify` section and refuses a list over its budget (rc 2, the existing one repair pass, then PLAN_MALFORMED). Resolved by _pvb_knob through `_LG_KIND=libs lane_knob` in a subshell, then the env, then the fallback in bin/lib/plan-verify-budget.sh, which equals the default here (tests/plan-verify-budget.bh-9779-test.sh K1).

knobs.zero_means: no check: the gate prints PLAN_VERIFY_BUDGET: off
knobs.note: 1: a plan whose Verify list breaks a rule below is refused by bin/plan-gate.sh. 0: the check is off fleet-wide.

The most distinct suites a Verify list names. 30 passes the BH-7921 named list (20 in the committed plan, 26 in the operator's count of the pool plan, about 12 min in all) and refuses a 279-suite list.

knobs.zero_means: no suite may be run on main
knobs.note: The most suites a Verify list asks to run on main as well (`run ... on main`, `head and main`). A loop over tests/ on main is always over it.

A named suite with a recorded duration over this is refused (durations from PLAN_VERIFY_DURATIONS, state/ci-durations/api.tsv, catalog/ci-suite-durations.tsv or state/test-impact-durations.tsv; none readable: the rule does not run). 488 s was the slowest BH-7921 suite; the others were under 50 s.
